profile.about: I'm a software developer with over 3 years of experience, specializing in the React and Next.js ecosystem. I consider myself highly product-driven; my goal isn't just to write clean code, but to deeply understand the business needs in order to build scalable architectures that solve real-world problems. I thrive on taking projects from their initial concept all the way through to production.

items.description: Led the end-to-end development of an ERP system for ISPs. Architected a modular system and established a Pixel-Perfect System Design. Integrated AI assistants, accelerating the development cycle by 45%.
Developed a custom real-time financial system, optimized the performance of a SaaS ecosystem, and contributed to the development of a global multi-tenant marketplace with robust internationalization.
Redesigned the UI and improved the overall usability of a spa booking system, implementing full internationalization. Additionally, developed the commercial landing page for its market release.
